craft_claim: Vague, syntactically impressive abstraction can be mistaken for profundity; this is the chief failure of the philosophical voice and the target of depth-performance diagnostics.

supporting_evidence.note: Across multiple studies, participants rated randomly generated buzzword statements as profound, and receptivity was associated with an intuitive cognitive style and lower reflectiveness; detecting vacuity required discernment of deceptive vagueness.
Documents impenetrable jargon and misused technical vocabulary functioning as unearned authority. Contested criticism, used only as documented professional criticism, never as sole support.

scope: Every form that uses abstraction for authority, especially academic-adjacent and marketing copy.
exceptions: Genuinely difficult ideas are not pseudo-profound; the diagnostic is whether a concrete consequence can be stated, not whether the sentence is hard.
